Metadata.title: Taka Sats
Metadata.description: An offline-first waste-to-Bitcoin programme for verified collection and Lightning payouts.

Home.title: Verified collection. Transparent payout.
Home.description: Taka Sats is the open, offline-first foundation for turning verified recycling work into traceable Lightning payouts.
Home.baselineDescription: The requirements are aligned, strict TypeScript is enforced, and the first deployment path is running.
Home.offlineDescription: Core supervisor work will save locally before any network request.
Home.verificationDescription: Collection, photo evidence, and payout records share one append-only audit trail.
Home.custodyDescription: Collectors bring a receive address; custodial provisioning stays disabled until legal review.
